text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, concerned about the rising trend in curbs on free trade, wants developing countries to stand up for their right to do business with whoever they want and wherever they like.
- A Malaysian youth political group is urging Malaysians to stop visiting or doing business in Australia to counter anti-Asian remarks made by independent Australian MP Pauline Hanson.
- Malaysia will not be affected by Taiwan's recent moratorium which seeks to abort or freeze new business ventures in Asean, Minister of International trade and Industry Rafidah Aziz said.
